verified_semantics: Vulkan 1.4 is required for the GPU path
vnode:gpu frames remain GPU resident across compatible consecutive GPU filters
std.GPUUpload and std.GPUDownload define residency boundaries
VSVulkan4 can export GPU plane memory and timeline semaphores when supported
Vulkan device UUID can be matched to foreign API device identity
CUDA interop reference code exists upstream
upstream_caveat: The R80 documentation describes the CUDA interop sample as reference code not yet run on NVIDIA hardware; FA3 therefore requires real current-host E2E before promotion.
